shortDescription: CPU, memory, disk, network, and installed tooling for this machine, at a glance.
longDescription: A desktop window over the about-system CLI: 30+ system metrics — CPU and GPU, memory and swap, disk usage, uptime, public IP and ISP, containers, open ports, and installed developer tooling — collected on demand and shown as a single readable panel. Ships the CLI inside the app, so nothing needs to be installed first.
